skills.name: bio-proteomics-data-import
skills.display_name: MS Data Import and Bookkeeping Strip
skills.description: Loads MaxQuant proteinGroups.txt, DIA-NN report.parquet and mzML into Python/R, removes decoy, contaminant and site-only rows, picks the right quant column, and diagnoses the missingness contract before any number is trusted.

skills.name: bio-proteomics-dia-analysis
skills.description: Runs DIA-NN in predicted-library or library-based mode and filters its report at the correct q-value level (precursor/protein-group) and context (run vs experiment-wide), with the window-design and demultiplexing decisions the analyst inherits.

skills.name: bio-proteomics-peptide-identification
skills.description: Target-decoy database search with Sage, Comet or MS-GF+, Percolator rescoring, and q-value or separate-search FDR estimation at the PSM and peptide level.

skills.name: bio-proteomics-protein-inference
skills.description: Groups proteins from peptide evidence under parsimony or a probability model and controls protein-level FDR separately from peptide-level FDR, reporting groups rather than proteins.

skills.name: bio-proteomics-quantification
skills.description: Computes label-free (MaxLFQ, DIA fragment-level), isobaric (TMT/iTRAQ, MS2 vs SPS-MS3) and SILAC quantities and summarises peptides to proteins with ratio-compression and normalisation handled explicitly.

skills.name: bio-proteomics-differential-abundance
skills.description: Tests for differentially abundant proteins with limma/DEqMS moderation and proDA/msqrob2/MSstats missingness modelling, treating missing values as left-censored rather than imputing them away.

skills.name: bio-proteomics-proteomics-qc
skills.description: Instrument-, identification- and quantification-level QC: mass accuracy, RT and peak shape, % MS2 identified, missed cleavages, contaminant load, missing-value rates and batch structure across a run series.

skills.name: bio-proteomics-ptm-analysis
skills.description: Site localisation with false-localisation-rate control, protein-level-adjusted PTM quantification with MSstatsPTM, and kinase-activity and functional triage on an enrichment that is biased by construction.

skills.name: bio-pathway-go-enrichment
skills.description: Gene Ontology over-representation on a protein hit list with clusterProfiler enrichGO, with the background universe treated as the decision it is.

skills.name: bio-experimental-design-batch-design
skills.description: Balances batch, plate, operator and processing-day nuisance variation against the biological variable so it stays estimable rather than confounded, before any sample is run.

skills.name: bio-workflows-proteomics-pipeline
skills.description: Orchestrates a full run from MaxQuant, DIA-NN or MSstats input through raw-distribution QC, completeness filtering and normalization to a tested contrast.
